projections.label: LINEAR PROJECTION (NOT A MEASUREMENT)
projections.basis: Extrapolated from 50,000 measured articles at 10107.77 rows/sec (generation + cleaning/Parquet). Assumes constant per-row cost; ignores I/O saturation, GC, Spark shuffle/network and schema growth.

caveats: Single-host local benchmark on 12 logical CPUs; NOT a cluster benchmark and NOT a Spark LDA/MapReduce end-to-end timing.
Linear projections are arithmetic extrapolations of measured rows/sec, not measurements. They assume constant per-row cost and ignore I/O saturation, GC, Spark shuffle/network, and schema growth.
Corpus is synthetic: the shipped generator is called once per chunk with seed + chunk_index; its limited vocabulary repeats across chunks unlike a real Kaggle archive.
Timings cover generation and cleaning/Parquet only; interpreter startup, generator prints, and JSON serialization are excluded.
1 MB = 1,048,576 bytes (MiB). Input CSV bytes are the uncompressed generated chunks; Parquet bytes are Snappy-compressed outputs.
article_id values are renumbered SCALE_00000000.. in cleaning because independently generated chunks reuse the generator's ART_ ids.
Temporary full-text CSV/Parquet artifacts are deleted after the run unless --keep-workdir is passed; only the JSON summary is retained.
